# GSLV.fr — Guillaume Stehelin de Taisne

> Operator and systems builder with 10+ years of experience scaling companies in complex environments.

## Who is Guillaume Stehelin de Taisne?

Guillaume Stehelin de Taisne (also known as Guillaume Stehelin) is a French operator and entrepreneur specialising in operational systems, pricing automation, and scaling e-commerce and service businesses.

**Current:** Founder & CEO of [Moverz](https://moverz.fr) — an AI-driven pricing and operations engine for the moving services market (founded 2025, €1M+ GMV in 3 months).

**Previous:**
- Co-founder of Ligerio (2021–2025) — French e-commerce platform for heavy flooring and wall coverings. Scaled from near-zero to €10M+ annual revenue, 50–100% YoY growth for 3 consecutive years, break-even March 2024, team of 40+, raised €3.9M (Go Capital, BPI France). Hired the first employee. Exited mid-2025.
- Finance & Operations, Rocket Internet / Africa Internet Group (2013–2017) — Operated across Cameroon (incorporated 7 entities in 8 months), Côte d'Ivoire (scaled Jumia CI from 100 to 350 employees with Francis Dufay), Nigeria, Ghana, Senegal, Algeria. Berlin mission: unblocked Glossybox sale to The Hut Group (August 2017) by completing IFRS restatement across 7 entities (France, Germany, UK, USA, Sweden, Norway, Austria) and resolving a 8-figure multi-country tax exposure.

**Education:**
- Harvard University (Extension School, Computer Science)
- Université Paris Dauphine

**Contact:** gdetaisne@gmail.com

## What GSLV.fr is

GSLV.fr is Guillaume Stehelin de Taisne's professional website. It contains:
- Long-form articles on operations, scaling, logistics, AI systems, and CFO/COO practice
- Information about his current and past work
- Details on his services as a fractional COO / operator

## Key articles

- [How We Scaled Ligerio to €10M Revenue](https://gslv.fr/en/blog/scaling-ligerio-ecommerce-10m-revenue-logistics-operations) — Operations, logistics, and systems in a 2.5-tonne average order e-commerce business. Covers dropshipping→consignment→own stock model, 20x throughput improvement, SEO war room, B2B channel.
- [What Rocket Internet Taught Me About Execution](https://gslv.fr/en/blog/rocket-internet-africa-execution-jumia-lessons) — Launching 7 companies in 8 months in West Africa, scaling Jumia CI, crisis operations (embezzlement, tax audits, social plans), Glossybox IFRS remediation and sale.

## Services

- **Operating Diagnostic** — 24–48h diagnostic of operations, workflows, systems and bottlenecks. Prioritized action plan.
- **Fractional COO** — Embedded operator for 3–12 month missions. Build systems, manage teams, drive execution.
- **Crisis Intervention** — Fast deployment in critical situations: CFO/COO replacement, restructuring, M&A unblocking.
